preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 400.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000 <= xi <= 1000 for xi, yi in nodes)
preconditions.description: Each x-coordinate must be between -1000 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000 <= yi <= 1000 for xi, yi in nodes)
preconditions.description: Each y-coordinate must be between -1000 and 1000.
All nodes must have distinct coordinates.

postconditions.description: The output must be either '-1' or a floating-point number representing the total length of the arcs.
If the output is a floating-point number, it must be non-negative.
